shellCommands.command: git diff && ls -a && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50
for f in next.config.ts lib/data.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; grep -ril "prefetch" . | head -40; cat /workspace/__agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -50

cd /workspace; node -p "require('next/package.json').version"; grep -o "prefetch\b[^,]*" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts | head; cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/partialPrefetching.md 2>/dev/null | head -60

cd /workspace; git diff --stat; find .next/server/app -path '*product*' | head -30; for f in $(find .next/server/app -path '*product*' -name '*.rsc' -o -path '*product*' -name '*.html'); do echo "== $f: $(grep -c 'Compact Widget' $f)"; done
cd /workspace; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer"; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace; git checkout tsconfig.json; git status --short; cat .gitignore
